BindCount.title: 媒体集当前绑定数

UpdateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the dataset was last modified, in RFC3339Nano format.

If the dataset has not been updated since it was created, this timestamp is the same as the creation timestamp
UpdateTime.description_zh:
数据集修改时间的时间戳，格式为RFC3339Nano。

创建数据集后，如果未更新过数据集，则数据集修改时间的时间戳和数据集创建时间的时间戳相同
UpdateTime.title: 更新时间

name: GetDataset

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html operation
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. You can obtain the name of the dataset from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称, 获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable real-time retrieval of file statistics. Default value: false.

If you set the value to true, FileCount and TotalFileSize in the response return true and valid values.

If you set the value to false, FileCount and TotalFileSize in the response return invalid values or 0
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要进行文件统计。默认值false，不需要进行文档统计。

需要进行文件统计。返回Dataset结构体中的FileCount和TotalFileSize真实有效。

不需要进行文件统计。返回Dataset结构体中的FileCount和TotalFileSize可能不正确也可能都为0
parameters.name: with_statistics
